# Code of Conduct

This code of conduct is based on the Ruby code of conduct. It provides
community guidelines for a safe, respectful, productive, and collaborative
environment for anyone willing to contribute to this community.

It applies to all community communication channels, referred to as
"collaborative spaces." Any violations of this code of conduct may be reported
by contacting one or more of the project maintainers directly.

## Community Expectations

- Participants will be tolerant of opposing views.
- Participants must ensure their language and actions are free of personal
  attacks and disparaging remarks.
- When interpreting the words and actions of others, participants should
  always assume good intentions.
- Harassment, as determined by the project maintainers, will not be tolerated.

## Reporting Issues

If you experience or witness behavior that violates this code of conduct,
please report it to the project maintainers. Reports will be handled with
discretion.

---

By participating in this project, you agree to abide by this code of conduct.
